summary: Dispatches pit/race status driver-table messages (IDs 506-513) when the race is active (dword_7D0308) and the track-condition state (flt_7CF3C8) is non-zero. Computes a classification v0 via sub_4FF130(&unk_8AFEC0) and an audio filter parameter v1 via AudioFilterParameterCalculation(&unk_8AFEC0), then switches on v0 to record and insert driver-table entries, gated by a temperature threshold (flt_8AFEF0 > 30.0) and a track-grip-average check ((flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 > 0.7). Called from sub_40DE60 (0x0040DE60).

local_names.v0: pit/session classification used as the switch selector
local_names.v1: audio filter parameter checked against the classification
local_names.v2: local driver-table entry buffer initialized with sentinel values

operations.description: Guard on dword_7D0308 being nonzero and flt_7CF3C8 != 0.0; the whole dispatch body runs only while the race is active and the track-condition state is non-zero.
Initialize the local driver-table entry buffer v2 with sentinel/default values via StructInitWithSentinelValues(v2).
Compute the classification v0 = sub_4FF130(&unk_8AFEC0) from the pit-condition structure.
Compute the audio filter parameter v1 = AudioFilterParameterCalculation(&unk_8AFEC0) from the same structure.
Dispatch on v0 through the jump table jpt_41BEB4 (0x0041C07C) with cases 2, 3, 4, 5 and a default return.
Case 2: when v1 != 2 fall through to the default entry 512; otherwise record message 506 via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and insert it with InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v2).
Within case 2, when flt_8AFEF0 > 30.0 record the follow-up message 507 and insert it as well.
Case 3: record message 509 when v1 is 3 or 2, otherwise record message 512; then the shared grip-average check may record message 513.
Shared track-grip-average threshold (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 > 0.7 that gates recording and inserting message 513.
Case 4: when v1 is 4 or 5 record message 510 and insert it, otherwise fall through to the default message 512 path.
Case 5: when v1 is 4 or 5 record message 511 and insert it, and the shared grip-average check may then record message 513; otherwise record message 512 and insert it.
Default case and the final case-2 path return without recording a message.
Invoked from sub_40DE60 (0x0040DE60) in the pit/session message path.
